Name: Faster Kegs and Preserves Jars (Quality Too)
Author: pomarf
Description:
[center][color=#a64d79][size=4][b]SPEED CHANGES DO NOT EFFECT MACHINES THAT ARE ALREADY RUNNING PRIOR TO INSTALLATION OR PRIOR TO CONFIG CHANGES.[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b][color=#a64d79][size=3]YOU MUST FINISH YOUR CURRENT CYCLES OR PICK UP AND RE-PLACE YOUR MACHINES FOR CHANGES TO TAKE EFFECT.[/size][/color][/b][/center]

[b][size=4]Kegs and Preserves Jars too slow for you? [/size]
[size=4]Well you're in luck![/size]

[size=4]This mod solves that personal problem once and for all.[/size]
[color=#666666][size=1]*Or at least until Stardew updates and this mod stops working.[/size][/color][/b]

[b][color=#ffffff]Speed up your Kegs and Preserves to be up to 30x as fast!
There are also options to preserve [/color][color=#666666][size=1](I know)[/size][/color][color=#ffffff] item quality so that if you put silver, gold, or iridium in you get [b]silver, gold, or iridium[/b] out![/color][/b]

[b][color=#ffffff]It should work with multiplayer, and it should work with most mods.[/color][/b]
